member.name: M:SIPSorceryMedia.Abstractions.PixelConverter.ToI420(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Byte[],SIPSorceryMedia.Abstractions.VideoPixelFormatsEnum)
member.summary: Attempts to convert an image buffer into an I420 format.
member.param: The width of the image in pixels.
The height of the image in pixels.

The stride of the image. Currently this method can only convert RGB and BGR formats. For those formats the stride is typically: width x bytes per pixel. For example for a 640x480 RGB sample stride=640x3. For a 640x480 BGRA sample stride=640x4. Note in some cases the stride could be greater than the width x bytes per pixel.
The buffer containing the image data.
The pixel format of the image.
member.returns: If successful a buffer containing an I420 formatted image sample.
